CAPTURE.APPLY_CAPTURE_ATOMICITY: No frozen requirement for one external apply+capture transaction. record_result owns internal application/occurrence construction; caller must not apply separately then pass TransitionReport as its supplied body. record_result and save are separate supported operations.
CAPTURE.CURRENT_V3_GAP: A15 currently dispatches apply_event only and capture reads prior input bundle. Native capture capability exists, but A15 per-target record/save/reader inputs and full-output comparison must be independently sealed before any future runner repair or execution.
EVENT_CONSTRUCTION_INPUTS: Explicit original Snapshot archive resolver when required
CAPTURE.EVENT_CONSTRUCTION_OUTPUT: New immutable native PersistenceBundle with updated current Snapshot and appended ExecutionEvent
CAPTURE.INPUT_AND_FAILURE_STATE: Pure application/record_result failure does not mutate original immutable bundle. Save failure may leave immutable staged events/archives; do not claim success/read eligibility. Identical immutable-file retry is allowed by native writer; no generic repeat of mutable event execution. Exact row retry/process plan unsealed.
CAPTURE.LEDGER_APPEND_ENTRYPOINT: codec.append_event internal to record_result; exact duplicate occurrence identity/body replays idempotently; conflict rejected
CAPTURE.PERSISTENCE_ATOMICITY: Each immutable file fsync-before-hard-link publication; conflicting existing/symlink targets reject. Event/archive files may be staged before bundle file; no multi-file atomic commit, no HEAD or directory-fsync guarantee from save_bundle. Reader eligibility only after successful complete save and exact publication verification.
PERSISTENCE_INPUTS: Updated replay-valid native bundle including new event
CAPTURE.PERSISTENCE_OUTPUT: Immutable event-<id>.json files, native canonical bundle-<id>.json and required Snapshot archives; returns path/native bundle ID
CAPTURE.REQUIREMENT_SOURCE: Frozen A15: canonical before/after identities/event trace and reload preserves invalidation; native bundle replay requires current state reconstructed from exact ordered events
CAPTURE.TRANSACTIONAL_ALTERNATIVE: codec.commit_event(bundle,supplied,output_dir,repo_root,snapshot_resolver=...) acquires local LOCK, checks authoritative HEAD/parent, records natively, publishes bundle and atomically replaces HEAD with directory fsync. Not selected or authorized here.

ROUTE_RECEIPT_SOURCE_PINS: Not additional SourceInvalidation fields; source/route/receipt/provenance applicability is validation/evidence context. Do not invent descriptor fields.
RUNNER_GAP: V3 apply_event alone does not record/persist occurrence; future exact adapter repair needs separately sealed contract, not applied here
